title: Mechanism of Luteolin in the Treatment of Primary Sjogren's Syndrome: a Study Based on Systems Biology and Cell Experiments.
authors: Chen, Xiaolu; Liu, Jian; Zhang, Xianheng; Ding, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过系统生物学和细胞实验探讨木犀草素治疗干燥综合征的机制，虽涉及分子对接和TNF通路，但核心是疾病治疗而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Primary Sjogren's Syndrome (pSS) is a chronic inflammatory autoimmune disease that manifests as dry mouth and eyes. Luteolin can repress immuno-inflammation and improve the function of exocrine glands. METHODS: Bibliometrics was used to visualize pSS-related key indicators. The efficacy of traditional Chinese medicines (TCMs) in pSS treatment was analyzed with the internal database containing the clinical records of pSS. Using the network pharmacology technology to identify involved pathways. Additionally, molecular docking and cell experiments were performed to screen and verify the therapeutic effect of luteolin on pSS. RESULTS: Key indicators that were selected according to the bibliometrics were worse in pSS and had certain compatibility and correlation with laboratory and immunoinflammatory indicators. After treatment, pSS patients showed improvements in the above indicators. The results of risk analyses revealed that TCMs were protective factors for laboratory indicators and key indicators. The main effective TCMs for pSS treatment and TNF pathways were identified with network pharmacology. Cell experiments validated that luteolin indeed improved the secretion dysfunction and inflammation of modeled human submandibular gland epithelial cells through the TNF/NF-kappaB pathway. CONCLUSIONS: TCMs may effectively improve transcription factors and immuno-inflammatory markers in pSS patients. Moreover, we hypothesized and verified the potential mechanism of action of luteolin in HSG cells.
abstract_zh: 引言：原发性干燥综合征（Primary Sjogren's Syndrome, pSS）是一种慢性炎症性自身免疫性疾病，表现为口干和眼干。木犀草素（Luteolin）可抑制免疫炎症并改善外分泌腺功能。方法：采用文献计量学（Bibliometrics）可视化pSS相关关键指标。利用包含pSS临床记录的内部数据库分析中药（traditional Chinese medicines, TCMs）在pSS治疗中的疗效。通过网络药理学（network pharmacology）技术识别涉及的信号通路。此外，进行分子对接（molecular docking）和细胞实验，以筛选并验证木犀草素对pSS的治疗效果。结果：根据文献计量学选定的关键指标在pSS中表现较差，并与实验室及免疫炎症指标具有一定的兼容性和相关性。治疗后，pSS患者上述指标有所改善。风险分析结果显示，中药是实验室指标和关键指标的保护因素。通过网络药理学确定了pSS治疗的主要有效中药及TNF通路。细胞实验验证了木犀草素确实通过TNF/NF-kappaB通路改善模型化人下颌下腺上皮细胞的分泌功能障碍和炎症。结论：中药可能有效改善pSS患者的转录因子和免疫炎症标志物。此外，我们假设并验证了木犀草素在HSG细胞中的潜在作用机制。
